name: steely
summary: A Python developer toolkit with beautiful terminal output: debugging decorators (logging, timing, variable tracking), a thread-safe Logger with Grafana/Loki shipping, provider-agnostic email (SMTP/Resend/HTTP), streaming speech-to-text (Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Google, Azure, AWS, WhisperLive), and FastAPI request recorders.
author: Tom Neto
